The first release of Legato: dictation and meeting notes for Windows, with speech recognition that runs on your PC.

Hold a shortcut, speak, and the text lands where you're typing. Record a meeting and Legato writes the transcript as it goes, tells the voices apart and, with an AI provider you add, writes a summary with decisions, next steps and timed details.

## What's in it

- **Dictation in any app**, with filler words dropped, numbers and lists tidied, and a tone and paste keys for each kind of app.
- **The Dictionary and snippets.** Names and terms spelled your way, learned from the words you fix; trigger phrases that paste saved text.
- **Notes** for meetings and voice memos: a live transcript, voices told apart (and recognised in later meetings once named), summaries, Save as Word for Google Docs, and Word copies kept in a Google Drive or OneDrive folder.
- **Scheduling without signing in.** Google Calendar or Outlook opens with the meeting filled in.
- **Transforms and Ask** with your own provider: Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Groq, Cerebras and others.
- **The Scratchpad, Insights**, and a bar, island or bubble that shows when Legato is listening.
- **Other apps**: an MCP server for AI apps (`legato --mcp`, off until you allow it) and answers for [Inyon](https://github.com/Abhash-Chakraborty/inyon)'s coding agents from the bar.

What you say stays on the PC. Only summaries, transforms and Ask send text out, to the provider you chose, once you add one.

## Install

Download `Legato_0.9.8_x64-setup.exe`, or `arm64` for Windows on Arm, and run it. It installs for your account without administrator rights. Setup checks your microphone and downloads a speech model for your languages (0.5 to 1.6 GB). To work in apps run as administrator, use the `.msi` instead, which installs for all users.

The installers aren't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": choose More info, then Run anyway. Every installer has a `.sig` beside it to [check it against the public key](https://github.com/Abhash-Chakraborty/legato#verify-release-signatures) first.

Coming from Handy? Legato moves Handy's settings, history and recordings into its own folders on first run, and leaves Handy's folder in place if anything goes wrong. Downloaded models are shared, so nothing is fetched twice.

Legato updates itself from here on: it checks this page's releases and asks before installing.
